author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Farmer bent over working: wide-brim hat with the face hung under it at top left, hunched back arching to the hip, striding legs, arm reaching down to a long slanted hoe whose blade turns up at the end.
omissions: Ground arc dropped; the second arm merges with the first at this size; the head is 9 clear of the shoulder (the hat-face is not a ring head, so no stick-figure mark).
